claims: C1 a conversation is valid input to the model consisting of a list of messages
C2 every message in a conversation contains a role and content

concepts.name: conversation
concepts.gloss: C is a conversation, a valid input to the model

concepts.name: conversation_contains_message
concepts.gloss: conversation C contains message M as part of its list
concepts.inference: the text describes a conversation as consisting of a list of messages; expressing this structural relationship requires this relation

concepts.name: conversation_definition
concepts.gloss: C is a conversation as defined: a list of messages where each message has a role and content

ontology.body: conversation(C), conversation_contains_message(C, M), message(M), message_role(M, R), message_content(M, Ct)
ontology.gloss: C is a conversation consisting of messages, each with a role and content
